findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "preflight_payment" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: identify, check_service_endpoint · Private data: identify, counterparty_check, vault_check, find_vaults, operator_check, list_vaults, find_agents, counterparty_history · Public sink: find_vaults, operator_check · Destructive: preflight_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: identify, check_service_endpoint · Private data: identify, counterparty_check, vault_check, find_vaults, operator_check, list_vaults, find_agents, counterparty_history · Public sink: find_vaults, operator_check · Destructive: preflight_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
